 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Liv Morgan has ascended to become one of the top WWE attractions of this generation. The girl who used to wait at Hooters debuted in WWE in the early 2010s and scratched and clawed her way to the top.
 Her first major WWE Women's title victory came in 2022 when she cashed in her Money in the Bank contract against Ronda Rousey. However, former WWE star and Morgan's Judgment Day member, Carlito, revealed that WWE still had a different perception of Morgan after that victory.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In a recent appearance on the Hitting the Turnbuckle Podcast , Carlito said that WWE didn't think of Liv Morgan as a top star of the women's division even after her victory over Ronda Rousey and becoming champion. Instead, they saw her as nothing major until Morgan kept moving forward and became a marquee attraction in her own right. Carlito added that he was immensely proud that The Miracle Kid proved them wrong.
 "I remember too like when she won the the the the championship the first time was like she was like the what do you call it? The uh, the lucky loser kind of thing, right?" Carlito recalled. 
"Like she kind of won, and then now they you know, I feel like the company didn't believe in her. So you know I'm very proud of her that she you know she made them believe in her, you know what I mean?"
 As of now, Liv Morgan is among the top WWE stars on the main roster and is currently the WWE Women's World Champion. She regained the title from Stephanie Vaquer at Money in the Bank 2026. However, her next challenge is on the horizon. Dominik Mysterio 's guireta will defend her title against Becky Lynch at Survivor Series.
 This will be a rematch from a few weeks ago on RAW, where Judgment Day ran interference and the title bout ended in a DQ. With Morgan facing a huge threat from Lynch for the second time, we will have to wait and see if she can keep her title reign intact after Survivor Series.
